title: Synthetic Hero -> Model B robustness input
description: Versioned, fail-closed contract for a synthetic robustness-shaped input that a Model B robustness consumer may read. It is deliberately shaped like post-evaluation robustness evidence (Hero decision, alternatives, per-alternative support and provenance) but every value is synthetic: no real #367 result, no real #314 output, no VALIDATION/TEST hand, no Hero EV, no Model A signal and no recommendation is consumed. additionalProperties is false everywhere and every block is required so an incomplete request fails closed instead of being silently enriched.

decision.description: The single Hero decision point being robustness-shaped. Only public Hero-side identity is carried: no Hero EV and no recommendation.

sizing.description: Hero target total in bb for the decision action, or null when the action has no sizing (e.g. FOLD).

alternatives.description: At least one candidate alternative. Each alternative carries the public EV envelope already evaluated for that alternative in the synthetic fixture, together with its route, source, uncertainty, paired delta versus best and support verdict.

route.description: Named evaluation route the alternative's values came through (e.g. the harness/provider route that produced the synthetic EV). A route is a provenance label only: information_boundary.route_as_predictive_target is false and a route must never be used as a predictive target or as an environment weight.

source.description: Provenance of the alternative's values inside the synthetic fixture (e.g. the synthetic or Monte-Carlo source that produced ev_bb). It is not evidence about real Hero strategy.

ev_bb.description: Public EV of the alternative in bb, or null when the synthetic fixture does not evaluate it (e.g. incomplete comparison set). Null means not evaluated, never zero.

uncertainty.description: Monte-Carlo style uncertainty envelope, kept separate from Model-B environment uncertainty, or null when not measured.

ci95.description: [low, high] 95% interval in bb with low <= high.

paired_delta_vs_best_bb.description: Paired delta of this alternative versus the best alternative of the comparison set, in bb, or null when no paired comparison exists.

support.description: Declared support verdict for the alternative: status uses the consumer status vocabulary, tier is a support tier label, ood marks an out-of-distribution environment that cannot be tested.

tier.description: Support tier label backing the verdict (e.g. LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH / VERY_HIGH / UNKNOWN). A tier never upgrades an unsupported status.

posterior_refs.description: Opaque references to posterior records used by the synthetic fixture, or null when not computed.

provenance.description: Fail-closed provenance of the synthetic input. All consumption flags are pinned false so this contract cannot be read as real #367 or #314 evidence.

information_boundary.description: Hard information boundary. Every flag is pinned false: this input is built from public Hero-side and Model B information only and must never be enriched with private or predictive-only signals.
